correctness.rationale: Direct neighborhood reconstruction gives \(N[v]=(V\setminus V_i)\cup\{v\}\). Different-part pairs force only \(s\ge3\); same-part pairs reduce to outside-part counts \(q_i\ge3,2,1\) according to two/one/zero omitted vertices. When \(n_i<s\) these inequalities are automatic, while when \(n_i\ge s\) they are equivalent to \(s_i\le s-3\). The generating function and minimum criterion are then exact bounded-composition counting. An independent exhaustive check over all ordered part profiles of total order 3 through 8 and all 43,176 vertex subsets matched the criterion exactly.
